trs.20: By those [angels] lined up in rows
trs.85: By those [angels] ranged in rows,
trs.22: By those who range themselves in ranks,
trs.203: By those (angels) ranged in ranks (or rows).

trs.20: And those who drive [the clouds]
trs.85: who rebuke reproachfully
trs.22: And so are strong in repelling (evil),
trs.203: By those (angels) who drive the clouds in a good way.

trs.20: And those who recite the message,<sup foot_note=197179>1</sup>
trs.85: and recite God’s word,
trs.22: And thus proclaim the Message (of Allah)!
trs.203: By those (angels) who bring the Book and the Qur’ân from Allâh to mankind [Tafsir Ibn Kathîr].

trs.20: Indeed, your God is One,
trs.85: truly your God is One,
trs.22: Verily, verily, your Allah is one!-
trs.203: Verily your Ilâh (God) is indeed One (i.e. Allâh):

verses.text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ

trs.20: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.<sup foot_note=197180>1</sup>
trs.85: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them, Lord of every sunrise.
trs.22: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all between them, and Lord of every point at the rising of the sun!
trs.203: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and all that is between them, and Lord of every point of the sun’s risings.<sup foot_note=154834>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ

trs.20: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
trs.85: We have adorned the lowest heaven with stars,
trs.22: We have indeed decked the lower heaven with beauty (in) the stars,-
trs.203: Verily We have adorned the near heaven with the stars (for beauty).<sup foot_note=154835>1</sup>

trs.20: And as protection against every rebellious devil
trs.85: and made them a safeguard against every rebellious devil:
trs.22: (For beauty) and for guard against all obstinate rebellious evil spirits,
trs.203: And to guard against every rebellious devil.

verses.text_uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ

trs.20: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,<sup foot_note=197181>1</sup>
trs.85: they cannot eavesdrop on the Higher Assembly––pelted from every side,
trs.22: (So) they should not strain their ears in the direction of the Exalted Assembly but be cast away from every side,
trs.203: They cannot listen to the higher group (angels) for they are pelted from every side.

trs.20: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
trs.85: driven away, they will have perpetual torment––
trs.22: Repulsed, for they are under a perpetual penalty,
trs.203: Outcast, and theirs is a constant (or painful) torment.

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ

trs.20: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
trs.85: if any [of them] stealthily snatches away a fragment, he will be pursued by a piercing flame.
trs.22: Except such as snatch away something by stealth, and they are pursued by a flaming fire, of piercing brightness.
trs.203: Except such as snatch away something by stealing, and they are pursued by a flaming fire of piercing brightness.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ

trs.20: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.
trs.85: So [Prophet], ask the disbelievers: is it harder to create them than other beings We have created? We created them from sticky clay.
trs.22: Just ask their opinion: are they the more difficult to create, or the (other) beings We have created? Them have We created out of a sticky clay!
trs.203: Then ask them (i.e. these polytheists, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Are they stronger as creation, or those (others like the heavens and the earth and the mountains) whom We have created?" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay.

trs.20: But you wonder, while they mock,
trs.85: You marvel as they scoff,
trs.22: Truly dost thou marvel, while they ridicule,
trs.203: Nay, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) wondered (at their insolence) while they mock (at you and at the Qur’ân).

trs.20: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
trs.85: take no heed when they are warned,
trs.22: And, when they are admonished, pay no heed,-
trs.203: And when they are reminded, they pay no attention.

trs.20: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.
trs.85: and resort to ridicule when they see a sign,
trs.22: And, when they see a Sign, turn it to mockery,
trs.203: And when they see an Ayâh (a sign, or an evidence) from Allâh, they mock at it.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
trs.85: saying, ‘This is no more than blatant sorcery.’
trs.22: And say, "This is nothing but evident sorcery!
trs.203: And they say: "This is nothing but evident magic!

verses.text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

trs.20: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
trs.85: ‘What! After we have died and become dust and bones, shall we really be raised up again,
trs.22: "What! when we die, and become dust and bones, shall we (then) be raised up (again)
trs.203: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we (then) verily be resurrected?

trs.20: And our forefathers [as well]?"
trs.85: along with our forefathers?’
trs.22: "And also our fathers of old?"
trs.203: "And also our fathers of old?"

trs.20: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
trs.85: Say, ‘Yes indeed, and you will be humiliated.’
trs.22: Say thou: "Yea, and ye shall then be humiliated (on account of your evil)."
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Yes, and you shall then be humiliated."

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

trs.20: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
trs.85: Just one blast and––lo and behold!––they will look
trs.22: Then it will be a single (compelling) cry; and behold, they will begin to see!
trs.203: It will be a single Zajrah [shout (i.e. the second blowing of the Trumpet)], and behold, they will be staring!

trs.20: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
trs.85: and say, ‘Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgement.’
trs.22: They will say, "Ah! Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!"
trs.203: They will say: "Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense!"

verses.text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

trs.20: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
trs.85: [It will be said], ‘This is the Day of Decision, which you used to deny.
trs.22: (A voice will say,) "This is the Day of Sorting Out, whose truth ye (once) denied!"
trs.203: (It will be said): "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ

trs.20: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds,<sup foot_note=197182>1</sup> and what they used to worship
trs.85: [Angels], gather together those who did wrong, and others like them, as well as whatever they worshipped
trs.22: "Bring ye up", it shall be said, "The wrong-doers and their wives, and the things they worshipped-
trs.203: (It will be said to the angels): "Assemble those who did wrong, together with their companions (from the devils) and what they used to worship,

verses.text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

trs.20: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
trs.85: beside God, lead them all to the path of Hell,
trs.22: "Besides Allah, and lead them to the Way to the (Fierce) Fire!
trs.203: "Instead of Allâh, and lead them on to the way of flaming Fire (Hell);

trs.20: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
trs.85: and halt them for questioning:
trs.22: "But stop them, for they must be asked:
trs.203: "But stop them, verily they are to be questioned.

trs.20: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
trs.85: “Why do you not support each other now?” ’––
trs.22: "'What is the matter with you that ye help not each other?'"
trs.203: "What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another (as you used to do in the world)?"

trs.20: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
trs.85: no indeed! They will be in complete submission on that Day––
trs.22: Nay, but that day they shall submit (to Judgment);
trs.203: Nay, but that Day they shall surrender.

trs.20: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.
trs.85: and they will turn on one another accusingly.
trs.22: And they will turn to one another, and question one another.
trs.203: And they will turn to one another and question one another.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

trs.20: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."<sup foot_note=197183>1</sup>
trs.85: They will say, ‘You came to us from a position of power.’
trs.22: They will say: "It was ye who used to come to us from the right hand (of power and authority)!"
trs.203: They will say: "It was you who used to come to us from the right side [i.e. from the right side of one of us and beautify for us every evil, enjoin on us polytheism, and stop us from the truth i.e. Islâmic Monotheism and from every good deed]."

trs.20: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
trs.85: They will say, ‘No! It was you who would not believe-
trs.22: They will reply: "Nay, ye yourselves had no Faith!
trs.203: They will reply: "Nay, you yourselves were not believers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ

trs.20: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
trs.85: we had no power over you- and you were already exceeding all limits.
trs.22: "Nor had we any authority over you. Nay, it was ye who were a people in obstinate rebellion!
trs.203: "And we had no authority over you. Nay! But you were Tâghûn (transgressing) people (polytheists, and disbelievers).

verses.text_uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ

trs.20: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
trs.85: Our Lord’s sentence on us is just and we must all taste the punishment.
trs.22: "So now has been proved true, against us, the word of our Lord that we shall indeed (have to) taste (the punishment of our sins).
trs.203: "So now the Word of our Lord has been justified against us, that we shall certainly (have to) taste (the torment).

trs.20: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
trs.85: We led you astray as we ourselves were astray.’
trs.22: "We led you astray: for truly we were ourselves astray."
trs.203: "So we led you astray because we were ourselves astray."

trs.20: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
trs.85: On that Day they will all share the torment:
trs.22: Truly, that Day, they will (all) share in the Penalty.
trs.203: Then verily, that Day, they will (all) share in the torment.

trs.20: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
trs.85: this is how We deal with the guilty.
trs.22: Verily that is how We shall deal with Sinners.
trs.203: Certainly, that is how We deal with Al-Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, disbelievers, criminals, the disobedient to Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

trs.20: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant
trs.85: Whenever it was said to them, ‘There is no deity but God,’ they became arrogant,
trs.22: For they, when they were told that there is no god except Allah, would puff themselves up with Pride,
trs.203: Truly, when it was said to them: Lâ ilâha illallâh "(none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh)," they puffed themselves up with pride<sup foot_note=154836>1</sup> (i.e. denied it).

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ

trs.20: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
trs.85: and said, ‘Are we to forsake our gods for a mad poet?’
trs.22: And say: "What! shall we give up our gods for the sake of a Poet possessed?"
trs.203: And (they) said: "Are we going to abandon our âlihah (gods) for the sake of a mad poet?"

trs.20: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
trs.85: ‘No: he brought the truth and confirmed the earlier messengers;
trs.22: Nay! he has come with the (very) Truth, and he confirms (the Message of) the messengers (before him).
trs.203: Nay! he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has come with the truth (i.e. Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism and this Qur’ân) and he confirms the Messengers (before him who brought Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism).

trs.20: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
trs.85: you will taste the painful torment,
trs.22: Ye shall indeed taste of the Grievous Penalty;-
trs.203: Verily, you (pagans of Makkah) are going to taste the painful torment;

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

trs.20: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
trs.85: and be repaid only according to your deeds.’
trs.22: But it will be no more than the retribution of (the Evil) that ye have wrought;-
trs.203: And you will be requited nothing except for what you used to do (evil deeds, sins, and Allâh’s disobedience which you used to do in this world)

trs.20: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
trs.85: Not so God’s true servants.
trs.22: But the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah,-
trs.203: Save the chosen slaves of Allâh (i.e. the true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).

trs.20: Those will have a provision determined -
trs.85: They will have familiar provisions––
trs.22: For them is a Sustenance determined,
trs.203: For them there will be a known provision (in Paradise),

trs.20: Fruits;<sup foot_note=197184>1</sup> and they will be honored
trs.85: fruits- and will be honoured
trs.22: Fruits (Delights); and they (shall enjoy) honour and dignity,
trs.203: Fruits; and they shall be honoured,

trs.20: In gardens of pleasure
trs.85: in gardens of delight;
trs.22: In Gardens of Felicity,
trs.203: In the Gardens of delight (Paradise),

trs.20: On thrones facing one another.
trs.85: seated on couches, facing one another.
trs.22: Facing each other on Thrones (of Dignity):
trs.203: Facing one another on thrones.

trs.20: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
trs.85: A drink will be passed round among them from a flowing spring:
trs.22: Round will be passed to them a Cup from a clear-flowing fountain,
trs.203: Round them will be passed a cup of pure wine -

trs.20: White and delicious to the drinkers;
trs.85: white, delicious to those who taste it,
trs.22: Crystal-white, of a taste delicious to those who drink (thereof),
trs.203: White, delicious to the drinkers.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ

trs.20: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
trs.85: causing no headiness or intoxication.
trs.22: Free from headiness; nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.
trs.203: Neither will they have Ghoul (any kind of hurt, abdominal pain, headache, a sin) from that, nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.

trs.20: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances,<sup foot_note=197185>1</sup> with large, [beautiful] eyes,
trs.85: With them will be spouses- modest of gaze and beautiful of eye-
trs.22: And besides them will be chaste women, restraining their glances, with big eyes (of wonder and beauty).
trs.203: And beside them will be Qâsirât-at-Tarf [chaste females (wives), restraining their glances (desiring none except their husbands)], with wide and beautiful eyes.<sup foot_note=154837>1</sup>

trs.20: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
trs.85: like protected eggs.
trs.22: As if they were (delicate) eggs closely guarded.
trs.203: (Delicate and pure) as if they were (hidden) eggs (well) preserved.

trs.20: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
trs.85: They will turn to one another with questions:
trs.22: Then they will turn to one another and question one another.
trs.203: Then they will turn to one another, mutually questioning.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ

trs.20: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].
trs.85: one will say, ‘I had a close companion on earth
trs.22: One of them will start the talk and say: "I had an intimate companion (on the earth),
trs.203: A speaker of them will say: "Verily, I had a companion (in the world),

trs.20: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
trs.85: who used to ask me, “Do you really believe that
trs.22: "Who used to say, 'what! art thou amongst those who bear witness to the Truth (of the Message)?
trs.203: Who used to say: "Are you among those who believe (in resurrection after death).

verses.text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ

trs.20: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
trs.85: after we die and become dust and bone, we shall be brought for judgement?”’
trs.22: "'When we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed receive rewards and punishments?'"
trs.203: "(That) when we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed (be raised up) to receive reward or punishment (according to our deeds)?"

trs.20: He will say,<sup foot_note=197186>1</sup> "Would you [care to] look?"
trs.85: Then he will say, ‘Shall we look for him?’
trs.22: (A voice) said: "Would ye like to look down?"
trs.203: (The speaker) said: "Will you look down?"

trs.20: And he will look and see him<sup foot_note=197187>1</sup> in the midst of the Hellfire.
trs.85: He will look down and see him in the midst of the Fire,
trs.22: He looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.
trs.203: So he looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.

trs.20: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.
trs.85: and say to him, ‘By God, you almost brought me to ruin!
trs.22: He said: "By Allah! thou wast little short of bringing me to perdition!
trs.203: He said: "By Allâh! You have nearly ruined me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ

trs.20: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
trs.85: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I too would have been taken to Hell.’
trs.22: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I should certainly have been among those brought (there)!
trs.203: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I would certainly have been among those brought forth (to Hell)."

trs.20: Then, are we not to die
trs.85: Then he will say [to his blessed companions], ‘Are we never to die again after our earlier death?
trs.22: "Is it (the case) that we shall not die,
trs.203: (The dwellers of Paradise will say) "Are we then not to die (any more)?

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

trs.20: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
trs.85: Shall we never suffer?
trs.22: "Except our first death, and that we shall not be punished?"
trs.203: Except our first death, and we shall not be punished? (after we have entered Paradise)."

trs.20: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
trs.85: This truly is the supreme triumph!’
trs.22: Verily this is the supreme achievement!
trs.203: Truly, this is the supreme success!

trs.20: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
trs.85: Everyone should strive to attain this.
trs.22: For the like of this let all strive, who wish to strive.
trs.203: For the like of this let the workers work.

verses.text_uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

trs.20: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?
trs.85: Is this the better welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum,
trs.22: Is that the better entertainment or the Tree of Zaqqum?
trs.203: Is that (Paradise) better entertainment or the tree of Zaqqûm (a horrible tree in Hell)?

trs.20: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
trs.85: which we have made a test for the evildoers?
trs.22: For We have truly made it (as) a trial for the wrong-doers.
trs.203: Truly We have made it (as) a trail for the Zâlimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, wrong-doers).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

trs.20: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
trs.85: This tree grows in the heart of the blazing Fire,
trs.22: For it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-Fire:
trs.203: Verily, it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-fire,

trs.20: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
trs.85: and its fruits are like devils’ heads.
trs.22: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of devils:
trs.203: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of Shayâtîn (devils);

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ

trs.20: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
trs.85: They will fill their bellies eating from it;
trs.22: Truly they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
trs.203: Truly, they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ

trs.20: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
trs.85: then drink scalding water on top of it;
trs.22: Then on top of that they will be given a mixture made of boiling water.
trs.203: Then on the top of that they will be given boiling water to drink so that it becomes a mixture (of boiling water and Zaqqûm in their bellies).

trs.20: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
trs.85: then return to the blazing Fire.
trs.22: Then shall their return be to the (Blazing) Fire.
trs.203: Then thereafter, verily, their return is to the flaming fire of Hell.

trs.20: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
trs.85: They found their forefathers astray,
trs.22: Truly they found their fathers on the wrong Path;
trs.203: Verily, they found their fathers on the wrong path;

trs.20: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
trs.85: and rushed to follow in their footsteps- before the disbelievers [of Mecca],
trs.22: So they (too) were rushed down on their footsteps!
trs.203: So they (too) hastened in their footsteps!

trs.20: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
trs.85: most men in the past went astray,
trs.22: And truly before them, many of the ancients went astray;-
trs.203: And indeed most of the men of old went astray before them;

trs.20: And We had already sent among them warners.
trs.85: even though We sent messengers to warn them.
trs.22: But We sent aforetime, among them, (messengers) to admonish them;-
trs.203: And indeed We sent among them warners (Messengers);

trs.20: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
trs.85: See how those who were warned met their end!
trs.22: Then see what was the end of those who were admonished (but heeded not),-
trs.203: Then see what was the end of those who were warned (but heeded not).

trs.20: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
trs.85: Not so the true servants of God.
trs.22: Except the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah.
trs.203: Except the chosen slaves of Allâh (faithful, obedient, and true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).

trs.20: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
trs.85: Noah cried to Us, and how excellent was Our response!
trs.22: (In the days of old), Noah cried to Us, and We are the best to hear prayer.
trs.203: And indeed Nûh (Noah) invoked Us, and We are the Best of those who answer (the request).

trs.20: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
trs.85: We saved him and his people from great distress,
trs.22: And We delivered him and his people from the Great Calamity,
trs.203: And We rescued him and his family from the great distress (i.e. drowning),

trs.20: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
trs.85: We let his offspring remain on the earth,
trs.22: And made his progeny to endure (on this earth);
trs.203: And, his progeny, them We made the survivors (i.e. Shem, Ham and Japheth).

trs.20: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
trs.85: We let him be praised by later generations:
trs.22: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations to come in later times:
trs.203: And left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations:

trs.20: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
trs.85: ‘Peace be upon Noah among all the nations!’
trs.22: "Peace and salutation to Noah among the nations!"
trs.203: "Salâm (peace) be upon Nûh (Noah) (from Us) among the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)!"

trs.20: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
trs.85: This is how We reward those who do good:
trs.22: Thus indeed do we reward those who do right.
trs.203: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).

trs.20: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
trs.85: he was truly one of Our faithful servants.
trs.22: For he was one of our believing Servants.
trs.203: Verily, he [Nûh (Noah)] was one of Our believing slaves.

trs.20: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].
trs.85: We drowned the rest.
trs.22: Then the rest we overwhelmed in the Flood.
trs.203: Then We drowned the others (disbelievers and polytheists).

trs.20: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
trs.85: Abraham was of the same faith:
trs.22: Verily among those who followed his Way was Abraham.
trs.203: And, verily, among those who followed his [Nûh’s (Noah)] way (Islâmic Monotheism) was Ibrâhîm (Abraham).

trs.20: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
trs.85: he came to his Lord with a devoted heart.
trs.22: Behold! he approached his Lord with a sound heart.
trs.203: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart [attached to Allâh Alone and none else, worshipping none but Allâh Alone - true Islâmic Monotheism, pure from the filth of polytheism].

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ

trs.20: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
trs.85: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are you worshipping?
trs.22: Behold! he said to his father and to his people, "What is that which ye worship?
trs.203: When he said to his father and to his people: "What is it that which you worship?

trs.20: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?
trs.85: How can you choose false gods instead of the true God?
trs.22: "Is it a falsehood- gods other than Allah- that ye desire?
trs.203: "Is it a falsehood - âlihah (gods) other than Allâh - that you desire?

trs.20: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
trs.85: So what is your opinion about the Lord of all the Worlds?’
trs.22: "Then what is your idea about the Lord of the worlds?"
trs.203: "Then what think you about the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists)?"

trs.20: And he cast a look at the stars.
trs.85: then he looked up to the stars.
trs.22: Then did he cast a glance at the Stars.
trs.203: Then he cast a glance at the stars,

trs.20: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
trs.85: He said, ‘I am sick,’
trs.22: And he said, "I am indeed sick (at heart)!"
trs.203: And he said: "Verily, I am sick<sup foot_note=154838>1</sup> (with plague). [He did this trick to remain in their temple of idols to destroy them and not to accompany them to the pagan feast)]."

trs.20: So they turned away from him, departing.
trs.85: so [his people] turned away from him and left.
trs.22: So they turned away from him, and departed.
trs.203: So they turned away from him, and departed (for fear of the disease).

verses.text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

trs.20: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?<sup foot_note=197188>1</sup>
trs.85: He turned to their gods and said, ‘Do you not eat?
trs.22: Then did he turn to their gods and said, "will ye not eat (of the offerings before you)?...
trs.203: Then he turned to their âlihah (gods) and said: "Will you not eat (of the offering before you)?

trs.20: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?".
trs.85: Why do you not speak?’
trs.22: "What is the matter with you that ye speak not (intelligently)?"
trs.203: "What is the matter with you that you speak not?"

trs.20: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
trs.85: then he turned and struck them with his right arm.
trs.22: Then did he turn upon them, striking (them) with the right hand.
trs.203: Then he turned upon them, striking (them) with (his) right hand.

trs.20: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.
trs.85: His people hurried towards him,
trs.22: Then came (the worshippers) with hurried steps, and faced (him).
trs.203: Then they (the worshippers of idols) came, towards him, hastening.

trs.20: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
trs.85: but he said, ‘How can you worship things you carve with your own hands,
trs.22: He said: "Worship ye that which ye have (yourselves) carved?
trs.203: He said: "Worship you that which you (yourselves) carve?

trs.20: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"
trs.85: when it is God who has created you and all your handiwork?’
trs.22: "But Allah has created you and your handwork!"
trs.203: "While Allâh has created you and what you make!"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ

trs.20: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."
trs.85: They said, ‘Build a pyre and throw him into the blazing fire.’
trs.22: They said, "Build him a furnace, and throw him into the blazing fire!"
trs.203: They said: "Build for him a building (it is said that the building was like a furnace) and throw him into the blazing fire!"

trs.20: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.
trs.85: They wanted to harm him, but We humiliated them.
trs.22: (This failing), they then sought a stratagem against him, but We made them the ones most humiliated!
trs.203: So they plotted a plot against him, but We made them the lowest.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

trs.20: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
trs.85: He said, ‘I will go to my Lord: He is sure to guide me.
trs.22: He said: "I will go to my Lord! He will surely guide me!
trs.203: And he said (after his rescue from the fire): "Verily, I am going to my Lord. He will guide me!"

trs.20: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
trs.85: Lord, grant me a righteous son,’
trs.22: "O my Lord! Grant me a righteous (son)!"
trs.203: "My Lord! Grant me (offspring) from the righteous."

trs.20: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
trs.85: so We gave him the good news that he would have a patient son.
trs.22: So We gave him the good news of a boy ready to suffer and forbear.
trs.203: So We gave him the glad tidings of a forbearing boy.

translation.text: So We gave him the glad tidings

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ

trs.20: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion,<sup foot_note=197189>1</sup> he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."
trs.85: When the boy was old enough to work with his father, Abraham said, ‘My son, I have seen myself sacrificing you in a dream. What do you think?’ He said, ‘Father, do as you are commanded and, God willing, you will find me steadfast.’
trs.22: Then, when (the son) reached (the age of) (serious) work with him, he said: "O my son! I see in vision that I offer thee in sacrifice: Now see what is thy view!" (The son) said: "O my father! Do as thou art commanded: thou will find me, if Allah so wills one practising Patience and Constancy!"
trs.203: And, when he (his son) was old enough to walk with him, he said: "O my son! I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you (offering you in sacrifice to Allâh). So look what you think!" He said: "O my father! Do that which you are commanded, In shâ’ Allâh (if Allâh wills), you shall find me of As-Sâbirûn (the patient)."

trs.20: And when they had both submitted<sup foot_note=197190>1</sup> and he put him down upon his forehead,
trs.85: When they had both submitted to God, and he had laid his son down on the side of his face,
trs.22: So when they had both submitted their wills (to Allah), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (for sacrifice),
trs.203: Then, when they had both submitted themselves (to the Will of Allâh), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (or on the side of his forehead for slaughtering);

trs.20: We called to him, "O Abraham,
trs.85: We called out to him, ‘Abraham,
trs.22: We called out to him "O Abraham!
trs.203: We called out to him: "O Abraham!

translation.text: And We called out to him

verses.text_uthmani: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

trs.20: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
trs.85: you have fulfilled the dream.’ This is how We reward those who do good-
trs.22: "Thou hast already fulfilled the vision!" - thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
trs.203: You have fulfilled the dream!" Verily thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See 2:112).

trs.20: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
trs.85: it was a test to prove [their true characters]-
trs.22: For this was obviously a trial-
trs.203: Verily, that indeed was a manifest trial.

trs.20: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,<sup foot_note=197191>1</sup>
trs.85: We ransomed his son with a momentous sacrifice,
trs.22: And We ransomed him with a momentous sacrifice:
trs.203: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice (i.e. كبش - a ram);

trs.20: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
trs.85: and We let him be praised by succeeding generations:
trs.22: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:
trs.203: And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.

trs.20: "Peace upon Abraham."
trs.85: ‘Peace be upon Abraham!’
trs.22: "Peace and salutation to Abraham!"
trs.203: "Salâm (peace) be upon Ibrâhîm (Abraham)!"

trs.20: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
trs.85: This is how We reward those who do good:
trs.22: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
trs.203: Thus indeed do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).

trs.20: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
trs.85: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.
trs.22: For he was one of our believing Servants.
trs.203: Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves.

trs.20: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.<sup foot_note=197192>1</sup>
trs.85: We gave Abraham the good news of Isaac- a prophet and a righteous man-
trs.22: And We gave him the good news of Isaac - a prophet,- one of the Righteous.
trs.203: And We gave him the glad tidings of Ishâq (Isaac) - a Prophet from the righteous.

translation.text: And We gave him glad tidings

verses.text_uthmani: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ

trs.20: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].
trs.85: and blessed him and Isaac too: some of their offspring were good, but some clearly wronged themselves.
trs.22: We blessed him and Isaac: but of their progeny are (some) that do right, and (some) that obviously do wrong, to their own souls.
trs.203: We blessed him and Ishâq (Isaac). And of their progeny are (some) that do right, and some that plainly wrong themselves.

trs.20: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
trs.85: We also bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron:
trs.22: Again (of old) We bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron,
trs.203: And, indeed We gave Our Grace to Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron).

trs.20: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
trs.85: We saved them and their people from great distress;
trs.22: And We delivered them and their people from (their) Great Calamity;
trs.203: And We saved them and their people from the great distress,

translation.text: And We saved both of them

trs.20: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
trs.85: We helped them, so they were the ones to succeed;
trs.22: And We helped them, so they overcame (their troubles);
trs.203: And helped them, so that they became the victors;

trs.20: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],
trs.85: We gave them the Scripture that makes things clear;
trs.22: And We gave them the Book which helps to make things clear;
trs.203: And We gave them the clear Scripture;

translation.text: And We gave both of them

trs.20: And We guided them on the straight path.
trs.85: We guided them to the right path;
trs.22: And We guided them to the Straight Way.
trs.203: And guided them to the Right Path.

translation.text: And We guided both of them

trs.20: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
trs.85: We let them be praised by succeeding generations:
trs.22: And We left (this blessing) for them among generations (to come) in later times:
trs.203: And We left for them (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.

trs.20: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
trs.85: ‘Peace be upon Moses and Aaron!’
trs.22: "Peace and salutation to Moses and Aaron!"
trs.203: "Salâm (peace) be upon Mûsa (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)!"

trs.20: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
trs.85: This is how We reward those who do good:
trs.22: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
trs.203: Verily, thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).

trs.20: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
trs.85: truly they were among Our faithful servants.
trs.22: For they were two of our believing Servants.
trs.203: Verily, they were two of Our believing slaves.

trs.20: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
trs.85: Elijah too was one of the messengers.
trs.22: So also was Elias among those sent (by Us).
trs.203: And verily, Iliyâs (Elias) was one of the Messengers.

trs.20: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?
trs.85: He said to his people, ‘Have you no fear of God?
trs.22: Behold, he said to his people, "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
trs.203: When he said to his people: "Will you not fear Allâh?

trs.20: Do you call upon Baʿl<sup foot_note=197193>1</sup> and leave the best of creators -
trs.85: How can you invoke Baal and forsake the Most Gracious Creator,
trs.22: "Will ye call upon Baal and forsake the Best of Creators,-
trs.203: "Will you call upon Ba‘l (a well known idol of his nation whom they used to worship) and forsake the Best of creators,

trs.20: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
trs.85: God, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?’
trs.22: "Allah, your Lord and Cherisher and the Lord and Cherisher of your fathers of old?"
trs.203: "Allâh, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?"

trs.20: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
trs.85: but they rejected him. They will be brought to punishment as a consequence;
trs.22: But they rejected him, and they will certainly be called up (for punishment),-
trs.203: But they denied him [Iliyâs (Elias)], so they will certainly be brought forth (to the punishment),

trs.20: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.
trs.85: not so the true servants of God.
trs.22: Except the sincere and devoted Servants of Allah (among them).
trs.203: Except the chosen slaves of Allâh.

trs.20: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
trs.85: We let him be praised by succeeding generations:
trs.22: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:
trs.203: And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.

trs.20: "Peace upon Elias."<sup foot_note=197194>1</sup>
trs.85: ‘Peace be to Elijah!’
trs.22: "Peace and salutation to such as Elias!"
trs.203: "Salâm (peace) be upon Ilyâsîn (Elias)!"

trs.20: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
trs.85: This is how We reward those who do good:
trs.22: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
trs.203: Verily, thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers, who perform good deeds totally for Allâh’s sake only - See V.2:112).

trs.20: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
trs.85: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.
trs.22: For he was one of our believing Servants.
trs.203: Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves.

trs.20: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
trs.85: Lot was also one of the messengers.
trs.22: So also was Lut among those sent (by Us).
trs.203: And verily, Lût (Lot) was one of the Messengers.

trs.20: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
trs.85: We saved him and all his family-
trs.22: Behold, We delivered him and his adherents, all
trs.203: When We saved him and his family, all,

trs.20: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].
trs.85: except for an old woman who stayed behind-
trs.22: Except an old woman who was among those who lagged behind:
trs.203: Except an old woman (his wife) who was among those who remained behind.

trs.20: Then We destroyed the others.
trs.85: and We destroyed the rest.
trs.22: Then We destroyed the rest.
trs.203: Then We destroyed the rest (the town of Sodom at the place of the Dead Sea now in Palestine).

trs.20: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
trs.85: You [people] pass by their ruins morning
trs.22: Verily, ye pass by their (sites), by day-
trs.203: Verily, you pass by them in the morning

trs.20: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
trs.85: and night: will you not take heed?
trs.22: And by night: will ye not understand?
trs.203: And at night; will you not then reflect?

trs.20: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
trs.85: Jonah too was one of the messengers.
trs.22: So also was Jonah among those sent (by Us).
trs.203: And, verily, Yûnus (Jonah) was one of the Messengers.

trs.20: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
trs.85: He fled to the overloaded ship.
trs.22: When he ran away (like a slave from captivity) to the ship (fully) laden,
trs.203: When he ran to the laden ship:

trs.20: And he drew lots<sup foot_note=197195>1</sup> and was among the losers.
trs.85: They cast lots, he suffered defeat,
trs.22: He (agreed to) cast lots, and he was condemned:
trs.203: Then he (agreed to) cast lots, and he was among the losers.

trs.20: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.<sup foot_note=197196>1</sup>
trs.85: and a great fish swallowed him, for he had committed blameworthy acts.
trs.22: Then the big Fish did swallow him, and he had done acts worthy of blame.
trs.203: Then a (big) fish swallowed him as he had done an act worthy of blame.

trs.20: And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,
trs.85: If he had not been one of those who glorified God,
trs.22: Had it not been that he (repented and) glorified Allah,
trs.203: Had he not been of them who glorify Allâh,

verses.text_uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

trs.20: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.<sup foot_note=197197>1</sup>
trs.85: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day when all are raised up,
trs.22: He would certainly have remained inside the Fish till the Day of Resurrection.
trs.203: He would have indeed remained inside its belly (the fish) till the Day of Resurrection.

trs.20: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
trs.85: but We cast him out, sick, on to a barren shore,
trs.22: But We cast him forth on the naked shore in a state of sickness,
trs.203: But We cast him forth on the naked shore while he was sick,

trs.20: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.<sup foot_note=197198>1</sup>
trs.85: and made a gourd tree grow above him.
trs.22: And We caused to grow, over him, a spreading plant of the gourd kind.
trs.203: And We caused a plant of gourd to grow over him.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ

trs.20: And We sent him<sup foot_note=197199>1</sup> to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
trs.85: We sent him to a hundred thousand people or more.
trs.22: And We sent him (on a mission) to a hundred thousand (men) or more.
trs.203: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (people) or even more.

trs.20: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
trs.85: They believed, so We let them live out their lives.
trs.22: And they believed; so We permitted them to enjoy (their life) for a while.
trs.203: And they believed; so We gave them enjoyment for a while.

trs.20: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?<sup foot_note=197200>1</sup>
trs.85: Now [Muhammad], ask the disbelievers: is it true that your Lord has daughters, while they choose sons for themselves?
trs.22: Now ask them their opinion: Is it that thy Lord has (only) daughters, and they have sons?-
trs.203: Now ask them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them?"

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ

trs.20: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
trs.85: Did We create the angels as females while they were watching?
trs.22: Or that We created the angels female, and they are witnesses (thereto)?
trs.203: Or did We create the angels female while they were witnesses?

trs.20: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
trs.85: No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say,
trs.22: Is it not that they say, from their own invention,
trs.203: Verily, it is of their falsehood that they (Quraish pagans) say:

trs.20: "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
trs.85: ‘God has begotten.’ How they lie!
trs.22: "Allah has begotten children"? but they are liars!
trs.203: "Allâh has begotten [offspring - the angels being the daughters of Allâh)?" And, verily, they are liars!

trs.20: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
trs.85: Did He truly choose daughters in preference to sons?
trs.22: Did He (then) choose daughters rather than sons?
trs.203: Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons?

trs.20: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
trs.85: What is the matter with you? How do you form your judgements?
trs.22: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
trs.203: What is the matter with you? How do you decide?

trs.20: Then will you not be reminded?
trs.85: Do you not reflect?
trs.22: Will ye not then receive admonition?
trs.203: Will you not then remember?

trs.20: Or do you have a clear authority?<sup foot_note=197201>1</sup>
trs.85: Do you perhaps have clear authority?
trs.22: Or have ye an authority manifest?
trs.203: Or is there for you a plain authority?

trs.20: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
trs.85: Bring your scriptures, if you are telling the truth.
trs.22: Then bring ye your Book (of authority) if ye be truthful!
trs.203: Then bring your Book if you are truthful!

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

trs.20: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].
trs.85: They claim that He has kinship with the jinn, yet the jinn themselves know that they will be brought before Him.
trs.22: And they have invented a blood-relationship between Him and the Jinns: but the Jinns know (quite well) that they have indeed to appear (before his Judgment-Seat)!
trs.203: And they have invented a kinship between Him and the jinn, but the jinn know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him) (i.e. they will be called to account).

trs.20: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,
trs.85: God is far above what they attribute to Him-
trs.22: Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the things they ascribe (to Him)!
trs.203: Glorified be Allâh! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!

trs.20: Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].
trs.85: the true servants of God do not do such things-
trs.22: Not (so do) the Servants of Allah, sincere and devoted.
trs.203: Except the slaves of Allâh, whom He chooses (for His Mercy i.e. true believers of Islâmic Monotheism who do not attribute false things unto Allâh).

trs.20: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
trs.85: and neither you nor what you worship
trs.22: For, verily, neither ye nor those ye worship-
trs.203: So, verily you (pagans) and those whom you worship (idols)

trs.20: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
trs.85: can lure away from God any
trs.22: Can lead (any) into temptation concerning Allah,
trs.203: Cannot lead astray [turn away from Him (Allâh) anyone of the believers],

trs.20: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.<sup foot_note=197202>1</sup>
trs.85: except those who will burn in Hell.
trs.22: Except such as are (themselves) going to the blazing Fire!
trs.203: Except those who are predestined to burn in Hell!

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

trs.20: [The angels say],<sup foot_note=197204>1</sup> "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.<sup foot_note=197203>2</sup>
trs.85: [The angels say], ‘Every single one of us has his appointed place:
trs.22: (Those ranged in ranks say): "Not one of us but has a place appointed;
trs.203: And there is not one of us (angels) but has his known place (or position);

trs.20: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
trs.85: we are ranged in ranks.
trs.22: "And we are verily ranged in ranks (for service);
trs.203: And verily, we (angels), we stand in rows (for the prayers as you Muslims stand in rows for your prayers);

trs.20: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."
trs.85: We glorify God.’
trs.22: "And we are verily those who declare (Allah's) glory!"
trs.203: And verily, we (angels), indeed are those who glorify (Allâh’s Praises i.e. perform prayers).

trs.20: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,<sup foot_note=197205>1</sup>
trs.85: [The disbelievers] used to say,
trs.22: And there were those who said,
trs.203: And indeed they (Arab pagans) used to say:

verses.text_uthmani: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

trs.20: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
trs.85: ‘If only we had a scripture like previous people,
trs.22: "If only we had had before us a Message from those of old,
trs.203: "If we had a reminder as had the men of old (before the coming of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم as a Messenger of Allâh),

trs.20: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."
trs.85: we would be true servants of God,’
trs.22: "We should certainly have been Servants of Allah, sincere (and devoted)!"
trs.203: "We would have indeed been the chosen slaves of Allâh (true believers of Islâmic Monotheism)!"

trs.20: But they disbelieved in it,<sup foot_note=197206>1</sup> so they are going to know.
trs.85: yet now they reject [the Quran]. They will soon realize.
trs.22: But (now that the Qur'an has come), they reject it: But soon will they know!
trs.203: But (now that the Qur’ân has come) they disbelieve therein (i.e. in the Qur’ân and in Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم , and all that he brought, - the Divine Revelation), so they will come to know!<sup foot_note=154839>1</sup>

trs.20: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
trs.85: Our word has already been given to Our servants the messengers:
trs.22: Already has Our Word been passed before (this) to our Servants sent (by Us),
trs.203: And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our slaves, the Messengers,

trs.20: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
trs.85: it is they who will be helped,
trs.22: That they would certainly be assisted,
trs.203: That they verily would be made triumphant,

trs.20: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.<sup foot_note=197207>1</sup>
trs.85: and the ones who support Our cause will be the winners.
trs.22: And that Our forces,- they surely must conquer.
trs.203: And that Our hosts! they verily would be the victors.

trs.20: So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.
trs.85: So [Prophet] turn away from the disbelievers for a while.
trs.22: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
trs.203: So turn away (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from them for a while,

trs.20: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
trs.85: Watch them: they will soon see.
trs.22: And watch them (how they fare), and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
trs.203: And watch them and they shall see (the punishment)!

trs.20: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
trs.85: Do they really wish to hasten Our punishment?
trs.22: Do they wish (indeed) to hurry on our Punishment?
trs.203: Do they seek to hasten on Our Torment?

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

trs.20: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
trs.85: When it descends on their courtyards, how ter-rible that morning will be for those who were warned!
trs.22: But when it descends into the open space before them, evil will be the morning for those who were warned (and heeded not)!
trs.203: Then, when it descends in their courtyard (i.e. near to them), evil will be the morning for those who had been warned!

trs.20: And leave them for a time.
trs.85: [Prophet], turn away from the disbelievers for a while.
trs.22: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
trs.203: So turn (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) away from them for a while,

trs.20: And see, for they are going to see.
trs.85: Watch them: they will soon see.
trs.22: And watch (how they fare) and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
trs.203: And watch and they shall see (the torment)!

verses.text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

trs.20: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
trs.85: Your Lord, the Lord of Glory, is far above what they attribute to Him.
trs.22: Glory to thy Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they ascribe (to Him)!
trs.203: Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!

trs.20: And peace upon the messengers.
trs.85: Peace be upon the messengers
trs.22: And Peace on the messengers!
trs.203: And peace be on the Messengers!

trs.20: And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
trs.85: and praise be to God the Lord of all the Worlds.
trs.22: And Praise to Allah, the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds.
trs.203: And all the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
